stemMd: How many solutions of sin x=1/2 lie in 0≤x<2π?
explanationMd: In one full cycle, sine is one half at π/6 and 5π/6. Both lie in the specified interval, and no endpoint is a solution.

distractorRationale.a: The value one half is within sine's range.
distractorRationale.d: There are only two crossings in one full cycle.
distractorRationale.b: Sine has the same positive value in two quadrants.
